♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through Libra in Swati, activating your 7th house of partnerships and agreements, while the Sun continues in Virgo in late Hasta in your 6th house. Mars and Jupiter travel together in Cancer in your 4th, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 12th, and Venus is retrograde in Libra in your 7th as well. This creates a strong emphasis on how you share space, time and decisions with others—especially where daily duties and emotional comfort are involved.

💼 Career: With the 6th and 7th houses lit, this is a relationship-with-colleagues day. You may be pushed to clarify work expectations with bosses, clients or collaborators. Swati’s airy quality supports negotiation and adjustment; you can renegotiate deadlines or rediscover a more balanced division of tasks. Just be mindful of Venus retrograde in your 7th: old patterns in professional partnerships—like doing more than your share or avoiding honest feedback—may resurface for revision.

❤️ Love: The Moon and retrograde Venus together in your house of partnership turn the emotional spotlight firmly on your one-to-one bonds. If you’re partnered, dynamics around fairness, listening and small courtesies are highlighted more than grand romance. A simple, sincere conversation about what each of you needs to feel considered can shift the tone. If single, you could reconnect with someone from the past or re-evaluate what “equal give-and-take” really means for you now.

💰 Money: Joint expenses, shared budgets and recurring service costs are in focus. The Sun in your 6th favours tidying up subscriptions, utilities, and payments connected to health or work tools. With Libra activated, you may want to rebalance who pays for what in a household or business partnership. Aim for transparent numbers rather than unspoken “shoulds”; avoiding resentment now will protect your finances later.

🧘 Advice: Notice where you automatically adjust to others and where you never bend at all. Today’s sky invites you to experiment with a middle path that respects both your initiative and others’ needs.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partnerships that last are built less on big promises and more on the everyday ways you show each other that fairness matters.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Libra Moon in Swati moves through your 6th house of routines, health habits and service, while the Sun in Virgo continues to energise your 5th house of creativity and pleasure. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 3rd house of skills and communications, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 11th, and retrograde Venus—your ruler—travels through Libra in your 6th. The emphasis is on reshaping daily life so it actually supports the joy and output you want.

💼 Career: This is a roll-up-your-sleeves but also rethink-the-system kind of day. The Moon and Venus retrograde in your 6th encourage you to question how you work, not just how much. You might spot inefficient habits, lopsided task-sharing or processes that no longer match your current level. Mars–Jupiter in your 3rd give you courage to propose better methods, write a new workflow, or finally learn a tool that makes things smoother.

❤️ Love: With your 5th and 6th houses activated, romance meets reality. If partnered, conversations about how you spend ordinary time together may feel more important than occasional special events. Little rituals—making breakfast together, a shared walk, designing a weekly “no phones” window—can refresh affection. If single, you may feel a tug toward someone from a work or service environment, but Venus retrograde suggests taking things slowly and observing how they handle responsibility before investing heavily.

💰 Money: Virgo and Libra influence practical yet aesthetic spending. You might feel drawn to upgrade tools, stationery, or your workspace to something more beautiful. As long as purchases genuinely increase efficiency or wellbeing, they’re well-timed. With Saturn in the 11th, be discerning about group expenses, subscriptions or memberships; ensure they still align with the communities and goals you care about now, not last year’s version of you.

🧘 Advice: Look at your schedule like a garden. Certain tasks need pruning, others need more attention. Adjusting the layout will often matter more than forcing more effort.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your daily life reflects your real values, even ordinary chores start to feel like part of your art.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati activates your 5th house of self-expression, romance and children, while the Sun in Virgo highlights your 4th house of home and emotional base. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer continue to emphasise your 2nd house of income and self-worth, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 10th, and Venus retrograde in Libra also stirs your 5th. The focus is on how your creative spark and emotional security feed each other—and how that plays out in public life.

💼 Career: With Saturn at the top of your chart and the Sun in your 4th, you may feel the tension between professional duties and family or private needs. Instead of trying to please everyone, aim to structure your time blocks more consciously. The Libra 5th-house Moon is excellent for presentations, design work, teaching, or anything that requires both intellect and charm. You can turn a dry topic into something engaging, especially if you allow personal examples or stories to enter your work.

❤️ Love: This is a heart-awakening day if you allow it. The Moon conjunct retrograde Venus in your 5th can resurface old crushes, memories of first loves, or questions about what romance has come to mean to you. If partnered, you may want to reintroduce play, humour or a creative project you can share. If single, you might notice a shift in what you find attractive—you’re less impressed by sheer intensity and more drawn to balance, taste and emotional reciprocity.

💰 Money: Mars–Jupiter in your 2nd can bring motivation to grow income or reshape how you earn, and today’s Libra influence asks: does this line of work feel creatively satisfying enough? You might explore monetising a talent—writing, design, music, teaching—but Saturn in the 10th reminds you to think in terms of sustainable effort, not overnight success. Budget-wise, watch for spending on entertainment or children that creeps beyond what’s comfortable.

🧘 Advice: Instead of choosing between duty and joy, look for one concrete way to weave your creativity into your responsibilities today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your ideas gain real power when they stop living only in your head and start taking shape in the spaces you actually inhabit.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra travels through your 4th house of home, inner peace and family patterns, while the Sun in Virgo activates your 3rd house of mind, communication and short trips. Mars and Jupiter in your own sign Cancer energise your 1st house, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 9th, and retrograde Venus in Libra sharpens your sense of beauty and balance in your living space. Today links your inner atmosphere with how you move through your local world.

💼 Career: You may feel both driven and sensitive. Mars–Jupiter in your 1st give you presence and ambition, but the Libra Moon in your 4th suggests you’ll do your best work if your base feels harmonious. Consider whether small adjustments at home—a tidier desk, a quieter corner, clearer boundaries with relatives—could markedly improve your focus. In work conversations, your tone matters: a calm, fair approach will be heard far better than emotional urgency.

❤️ Love: Emotional comfort is a priority today, and you could be more aware than usual of how your living situation affects your relationships. If partnered, you may want to have a gentle discussion about domestic roles, aesthetics or how each of you restores energy at home. Swati encourages respectful negotiation. If single, you might feel drawn to someone who appreciates your sensitivity but also respects your need for personal space and a peaceful nest.

💰 Money: With Cancer and Libra active, expenses related to home, decor, and family comforts are highlighted. Mars–Jupiter can bring bold decisions—renovations, moves, big purchases—but Saturn in the 9th asks you to double-check long-term implications: leases, mortgages, long-distance relocations, or study tied to relocation. Also pay attention to neighbourhood expenses: transport, communications or small gadgets that support your daily rhythm.

🧘 Advice: Notice which conversations leave you feeling more settled and which leave you buzzing restlessly. Choose today to invest time in the ones that soothe your system.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: A calm base is not a luxury for you; it’s the power source that lets your care for others shine without burning you out.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati activates your 3rd house of communication, siblings and daily logistics, while the Sun in Virgo occupies your 2nd house of resources and speech. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer stir your 12th house of retreat and the subconscious, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 8th, and Venus retrograde in Libra joins the Moon in your 3rd. The theme is refining how you speak, write and negotiate—especially around money and subtle emotional undercurrents.

💼 Career: You’re likely fielding messages, meetings and minor crises, but the deeper task is refining your voice. Virgo in your 2nd favours sharpening your language in emails, presentations and pitches so you sound both clear and grounded. Libra in your 3rd helps with diplomacy, especially if you’ve recently had tension with colleagues or clients. With Mars–Jupiter behind the scenes, much of your real effort may be invisible; avoid resentment by reminding yourself which hidden labours are strategic and which you can let go.

❤️ Love: The 3rd-house focus makes everyday communication with loved ones especially important. If partnered, be aware of how tone and timing affect your message—sometimes a short, warm check-in is more effective than a long, serious talk launched at the wrong moment. With Venus retrograde here, you may re-examine patterns like silent expectations, teasing that goes too far, or delaying difficult but necessary conversations. If single, connection can spark through messages, shared interests or short trips.

💰 Money: The Sun in your 2nd pushes you to look frankly at your earning and spending. You may feel motivated to adjust fees, ask for clarity about compensation, or refine a budget. Saturn in your 8th advises caution regarding shared finances, taxes, or loans; you might use today to read fine print or schedule a future consultation. Avoid impulsive purchases made to relieve boredom during commutes or online browsing.

🧘 Advice: Instead of trying to control outcomes with big gestures, focus on the small, precise words and actions that actually move things forward.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your message carries both honesty and grace, doors open that force alone could never unlock.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati moves through your 2nd house of finances, speech and self-value, while the Sun—your current guest—is still in Virgo in your 1st house, spotlighting your body, persona and direction. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer energise your 11th house of networks and long-term goals, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 7th, and retrograde Venus in Libra adds nuance to questions of worth and fairness. Today asks how confidently you can own your value in front of others.

💼 Career: With the Sun in your sign and the Moon in your money house, this is a favourable day to discuss compensation, refine pricing, or update how you describe what you do. You may be seen as capable and detail-oriented; use that to negotiate from a place of grounded self-respect rather than apology. Networks and communities (11th house) can offer opportunities, but Saturn in the 7th reminds you to choose collaborations where responsibilities and credit are clearly shared.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes remain serious with Saturn opposite you, but today’s Libra Moon softens the edges by bringing focus to the simple acts of respect that build trust. If partnered, conversations around shared expenses, contributions and appreciation could come up. If single, you may evaluate potential partners through the lens of how they treat your time, work and boundaries. Venus retrograde can bring back someone or something from the past for reconsideration—but you’re different now, and your choices can reflect that.

💰 Money: This is an excellent day for practical steps: balancing accounts, tracking small leaks, and aligning spending with who you’re becoming rather than who you’ve been. With Mars–Jupiter in your 11th, you might also see gains linked to friends, groups or online platforms, though it may be more about future potential than instant cash. Avoid undercharging out of fear; Libra’s influence helps you find a number that feels fair to both sides.

🧘 Advice: Let your decisions today be guided by a simple question: “If I respected my own efforts a little more, what would I adjust?”

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The moment you stop shrinking your worth to keep things easy, life starts sending you opportunities that actually fit you.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through your own sign in Swati, joining retrograde Venus in Libra in your 1st house, while the Sun in Virgo occupies your 12th house of rest, reflection and release. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 10th house of career and visibility, and Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 6th. You’re in a moment where who you are becoming is being quietly rewritten in the background of very public responsibilities.

💼 Career: Mars–Jupiter at the top of your chart keep the demands high; you may be pulled into leadership, problem-solving or visible decisions. Yet the Sun in your 12th suggests that what you truly need is to step back periodically and assess whether the roles you’re playing still fit. With the Moon and Venus retrograde in your 1st, you might question your professional image, style or even the direction of your work. It’s a good day to experiment with small changes rather than dramatic exits.

❤️ Love: The focus is strongly on you—your desires, your patterns, and how you show up in relationships. Past themes in love can reappear, not to trap you but to offer a second look. If partnered, you may feel more sensitive to how you’re perceived and whether your efforts are acknowledged. Instead of waiting to be guessed, share the shifts you’re going through. If single, you may oscillate between craving connection and craving space; honour both, and don’t force a neat label just yet.

💰 Money: With the 6th and 10th houses alive, financial matters are closely tied to work structure and workload. You might consider whether your current schedule is sustainable for the income it brings. Saturn suggests taking a sober look at obligations, debts or routines that eat time but don’t pay off. Today favours quiet planning—drafting a new strategy, not yet broadcasting it.

🧘 Advice: Treat this day as a gentle recalibration rather than a final verdict on who you must be. You’re allowed to adjust your trajectory as you understand yourself more clearly.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Redefining yourself isn’t selfish; it’s how you make sure the love and work you give the world actually come from your real centre.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra travels through your 12th house of solitude, dreams and the unseen, while the Sun in Virgo highlights your 11th house of friendships, causes and future plans. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 9th house of beliefs and long journeys, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 5th, and retrograde Venus in Libra deepens inner reflection. Outwardly, people may see you as future-focused; inwardly, you’re quietly sorting old stories.

💼 Career: The 9th and 11th house emphasis favours strategic thinking about the long arc of your career—studies, relocations, or shifting your role within a network or industry. You may feel drawn to communities, mentors or learning that align more closely with your deeper convictions. Yet the 12th-house Moon suggests you’ll benefit from working alone for stretches today, especially for research, planning or letting ideas incubate before sharing them widely.

❤️ Love: This is a more introspective day for the heart. The 12th-house Moon often heightens sensitivity, dreams and subtle intuitions about relationships. If partnered, you might sense unspoken feelings or fatigue under the surface; instead of pushing for immediate answers, create a gentle container—quiet time together, a walk, or simply being present without agenda. If single, you may revisit past romantic chapters in your mind; pay attention to what patterns you’re finally ready to release.

💰 Money: Communities, friends and long-term projects can have financial implications now—shared ventures, crowdfunding, or professional associations. The Sun in your 11th helps you see where group involvement may eventually pay off, and where it mainly consumes resources. Saturn in the 5th advises moderation in speculative investments or spending on entertainment; aim for deliberate, not compulsive, risks.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to be a little quieter than usual. Let insights arise in the spaces where you’re not trying to control every outcome.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Some of your most important course corrections happen not in confrontation, but in the quiet moments where you finally listen to yourself.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati activates your 11th house of friends, alliances and aspirations, while the Sun in Virgo travels through your 10th house of career and public role. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer stir your 8th house of shared resources and deep changes, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 4th, and retrograde Venus in Libra joins the Moon in your 11th. This is a highly social yet strategically serious day, asking who really belongs in your long-term circle.

💼 Career: With the Sun strong at the top of your chart, you’re visible and perhaps more accountable than usual. It’s a powerful time for clarifying your public direction, talking with supervisors, or taking the lead on a project. The Libra 11th-house Moon favours networking, but Venus retrograde warns against chasing popularity for its own sake. Focus on 2–3 key relationships that genuinely support your professional path, rather than scattering energy across every group.

❤️ Love: Friends, communities or online spaces could play a role in your romantic story today. If partnered, engaging together in a group activity, shared cause or gathering can bring fresh energy to the bond, provided you balance social time with private check-ins. If single, attraction may arise with someone you know from a community, team or platform; go slowly, and watch how they behave in group settings—that’s part of who they really are.

💰 Money: The 8th-house activation asks you to look at joint finances, inheritances, taxes, or contracts that bind you with others. This isn’t necessarily crisis energy, but it is a nudge toward greater clarity. With Saturn in your 4th, decisions around property, living arrangements or family obligations may intersect with money discussions. It’s a good day to map the terrain rather than make final moves—see clearly what you owe, what is owed, and what can be restructured.

🧘 Advice: Let your vision lead your social choices. Ask yourself whether the spaces you’re in actually move you closer to the life you’re aiming at.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The right allies don’t just cheer for you—they help you become the person your future already needs.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra travels through your 10th house of status, responsibility and reputation, while the Sun in Virgo occupies your 9th house of worldview, learning and distant horizons. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer energise your 7th house of partnerships, Saturn retrogrades in your own sign’s neighbour Pisces in your 3rd, and retrograde Venus in Libra colours how you’re seen professionally. It’s a moment of reassessing what kind of authority you actually want to embody.

💼 Career: This is a high-visibility day; others may look to you for decisions, mediation or a clear plan. The Libra Moon encourages a diplomatic style of leadership—you can bridge differences and bring people to the table. With Venus retrograde here, questions about your professional image, role title, or work–life balance could feel louder. The Sun in your 9th favours thinking beyond immediate tasks: courses, certifications or strategic pivots that expand your future options.

❤️ Love: With your 7th house active, partners or close allies may need more of your attention, even as career pulls strongly. Saturn in the 3rd suggests that honest, grounded conversations—about schedules, plans, or communication habits—can strengthen bonds. If single, you may meet someone through work, study, or social responsibilities; notice who respects your time and ambitions instead of only your usefulness.

💰 Money: Professional choices now have clear financial implications. You might consider renegotiating terms, exploring a new role, or taking on responsibilities that change your income trajectory. At the same time, Mars–Jupiter in your 7th warn against entering agreements purely out of enthusiasm; ensure contract details and expectations are mutual. The 9th-house Sun supports consulting experts or mentors before making big commitments.

🧘 Advice: Take a moment today to define success on your own terms—not the version you absorbed from family or industry norms.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your ambitions line up with what you truly believe in, discipline stops feeling like duty and starts feeling like alignment.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Swati moves through your 9th house of wisdom, travel and belief systems, while the Sun in Virgo lights up your 8th house of depth, intimacy and shared resources. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 6th house of work and health, Saturn retrogrades in Pisces in your 2nd, and retrograde Venus in Libra invites you to re-examine your guiding narratives. Today’s questions are: what do you really stand for, and how does that show up in the way you work and share?

💼 Career: Mars–Jupiter in your 6th can bring a surge of tasks, but also the drive to handle them. Still, the 9th-house Moon reminds you to connect what you do each day with a larger purpose, or at least a clear learning curve. This is a strong day for studying, teaching, legal matters, or international or cross-cultural projects. The Virgo 8th-house Sun also favours research, audits, or quietly digging into the details of contracts or complex systems.

❤️ Love: Deeper themes in intimacy, trust and worldview may surface. If partnered, you could find yourselves discussing beliefs, ethics or plans involving moves, study or shared investments. These conversations don’t have to be heavy; the Libra Moon supports a fair, listening-based approach. If single, you may be drawn toward people from different backgrounds or with perspectives that stretch your own. Venus retrograde suggests revisiting old ideas about what kind of partner fits your future path.

💰 Money: With Saturn in your 2nd and the Sun in your 8th, money matters call for maturity. It’s a good day to review shared accounts, loans, insurances or tax-related issues—and to distinguish between real obligations and inherited guilt. The Libra 9th-house influence can help you seek balanced advice: from a mentor, advisor, or well-informed friend who thinks long-term.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity guide you beyond your usual mental borders, but keep your feet on the ground when it comes to practical commitments.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The beliefs that truly shape your life are the ones you prove with the way you handle work, money and promises—every single day.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra travels through your 8th house of transformation, shared resources and emotional depths, while the Sun in Virgo occupies your 7th house of partnership. Mars and Jupiter in Cancer activate your 5th house of creativity and romance, Saturn retrogrades in your own sign Pisces in the 1st, and retrograde Venus in Libra intensifies your awareness of subtle power dynamics. This is a day of looking honestly at what you share—with lovers, collaborators and even your own past selves.

💼 Career: The 7th-house Sun emphasises collaborations, clients and contracts. You may find that one-to-one interactions carry more weight than group meetings. Pisces Saturn in your 1st wants you to show up as your mature self: clear about what you can deliver, clear about what you cannot. The Libra 8th-house Moon is ideal for gently renegotiating terms, fees or responsibilities in existing agreements so that they feel more balanced for everyone involved.

❤️ Love: Emotional intensity may rise, but it doesn’t have to spill into drama. If partnered, topics around trust, shared finances, emotional labour or intimacy could arise; approach them as a team problem to solve, not a battle to win. If single, you might feel magnetised toward people with a certain mystery or emotional depth. Venus retrograde here suggests it’s wise to watch how consistent they are over time before fully opening your heart or merging lives.

💰 Money: The 8th-house emphasis focuses on debts, inheritances, taxes, or money tied up with others. This is a good day to bring hidden numbers into the light—make lists, gather documents, or schedule a future discussion. Mars–Jupiter in your 5th can tempt you toward generous spending on hobbies, romance or children; as long as you’re aware of the bigger picture, a bit of joy is not a problem. Saturn in your 1st, however, encourages you to prioritise long-term stability over short-lived thrills.

🧘 Advice: Instead of fearing what lies beneath the surface, meet it with slow, clear-eyed attention. Truth tends to feel less overwhelming when you give it structure.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Real closeness isn’t created by avoiding hard topics—it grows each time you face them together without abandoning yourself.
